design.aggregate: plannedProgress = sum(weight * completion) / sum(weight) over selected logical nodes. Only verified contributes completion. Track observedWork, success/outcome, failure/blocked/incomplete counts, and eventsObserved independently. Empty selected work is indeterminate.
design.contract: Define one versioned JSON ProgressDocument with graphRevision, revision, items, aggregate projections, and update metadata. Define ProgressItem by run/graphRevision/phase/node identity, positive immutable weight, state, verifiedFraction, attempt, childRunId, evidenceRefs, receiptId, and blocker. Render human bars only from this record.
design.durability: Extend the existing durable store with saveProgress/loadProgress using expected revision and fencing token. Reject stale writers or merge deterministically; keep progress loss from changing cursor/receipt recovery. Version snapshots by graph revision and preserve remediation lineage.
design.lifecycle: Create pending items during compiled graph materialization; activate before dispatch; update attempt/child lineage on retry; mark verified only after child/evidence/gate/review acceptance; mark incomplete or blocked for their distinct causes; preserve terminal receipt authority.
design.skills: Replace the tracker contract in all 14 root/payload SKILL.md files with default-on semantics, exact activation/quiet rules, 3–6 skill-specific milestones, weights, scope-change and unknown handling, and safety-specific redaction for browse/upload.
design.testing: Use schema tests, pure aggregate tests, orchestrator lifecycle tests, store/CAS/reopen tests, all-14 root/payload contract tests, bootstrap/index tests, and final repository gates. Telemetry deletion/loss must not prevent progress recovery.
